data.title: Which Major Cryptocurrency Has the Most Potential for Growth? Ranking Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana by Distance from Their All-Time Highs
data.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana all crashed from their 2025 peaks, but one of them stands out as having a uniquely powerful combination of factors that could fuel a sharper recovery than the others.
